title: Strict chain-square representatives of single-module union base change
statement: For arbitrary p:Y→B, g:A→B, opens U,V of Y and a module N on their union, use the standard derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and write a,aU,aV,aUV for the four canonical single-module comparison arrows [def-pc-standard-single-base-change-map], with their literal tensor-pullback coefficients [def-pc-module-pullback]. There are complexes C,D,C′,D′ of module sheaves on A, maps t:C→D, t′:C′→D′, α:C→C′, β:D→D′ and hc:t≫β=α≫t′. Six isomorphisms identify Q(C),Q(D),Q(Cone(t)) with a.left,aU.left⊕aV.left,aUV.left and the primed objects with their right sides. Under these isomorphisms Q(α),Q(β),Q(Cone.map(t,t′,α,β,hc)) identify with a.hom,biprod.map(aU.hom,aV.hom),aUV.hom. This asserts only chain-square and cone identifications, no short complex or short exactness on A.

source.place: Tags 08BV (Lemma 20.33.2), 08HZ (functorial relative Mayer–Vietoris, Lemma 20.33.5), 08FE (Lemma 20.32.4), 08HY (Remark 20.28.3), 0DJ9 (relative Mayer–Vietoris induction diagram); 013N (Lemma 13.9.6) and 013O (Remark 13.9.7, the cylinder contraction calculation). Official pages checked in the second reading, 2026-10-14.

proof.text: Resolve the two single coefficients on W and W_A with injective-term K-injective complexes. The injective Mayer-Vietoris rows on the covers are short exact by gluing and flasqueness, so the cones of their first arrows represent the overlap terms.

Apply derived direct image and source derived pullback to the finite cover diagrams, using diagram resolutions. Transpose the ordinary pullback counit, restrict it, and use the underived open counit square to retain the homotopies of both restriction squares. Rectify the first square by functorial cylinders carrying those homotopies. The resulting strict square has its standard functorial cone map identified with the overlap comparison.

Transport vertices by direct-image composition, exact open restriction and additive biproduct comparison. Pasting the derived adjunction counits identifies alpha with the union comparison, beta with the biproduct of the member comparisons, and the functorial cone map with the overlap comparison. Empty or repeated opens and zero coefficients are zero or split cases of this construction.

lean.statement:
theorem standardSingle_union_ses_chain_data
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) (g : A ⟶ B) (U V : Y.Opens)
    (N : (U ⊔ V).toScheme.Modules) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    let a := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p) N g)
    let aU := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap (U.ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE le_sup_left) N) g)
    let aV := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap (V.ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE le_sup_right) N) g)
    let aUV := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans le_sup_left)) N) g)
    ∃ (C D C' D' : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings A.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
      (t : C ⟶ D) (t' : C' ⟶ D') (α : C ⟶ C') (β : D ⟶ D'),
      ∃ (hc : t ≫ β = α ≫ t')
        (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C ≅ a.left)
        (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj D ≅ aU.left ⊞ aV.left)
        (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t) ≅ aUV.left)
        (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C' ≅ a.right)
        (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj D' ≅ aU.right ⊞ aV.right)
        (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t') ≅ aUV.right),
        DerivedCategory.Q.map α ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ a.hom ∧
        DerivedCategory.Q.map β ≫ e₂'.hom = e₂.hom ≫ biprod.map aU.hom aV.hom ∧
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.map t t' α β hc) ≫ e₃'.hom =
          e₃.hom ≫ aUV.hom
